say:4:1821432002:1.text: Clarisa takes the ingredients and hurriedly begins preparing them. Her hand keeps stirring the soup while her eyes dart toward the kitchen door.

say:5:1821432003:1.text: Steam clouds her face. After a long hesitation, she empties an entire packet of powder into the pot with a trembling hand.
